description: Human-curated ground truth evaluation dataset featuring standard and adversarial edge cases.

test_cases.email_text: Hey, my payment went through twice for this month's subscription. Can I get a refund?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer requests a refund for a duplicate subscription payment.
Customer is briefly asking for a refund.

test_cases.email_text: Hellow, my accout is locked and I cant logiin no matter what I try. Please fix!!
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer cannot log in because their account is locked.
test_cases.notes: Contains heavy spelling typos (accout, cant, logiin, Hellow).

test_cases.email_text: The mobile app crashes with error code 500 every single time I click upload profile picture.
test_cases.expected_summary: The mobile app crashes with error code 500 when attempting to upload a profile picture.
test_cases.notes: Standard technical bug report with error code.

test_cases.email_text: مرحبا، my password reset link isn't working أرجو المساعدة
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer needs assistance because their password reset link is not working.

test_cases.email_text: Oh fantastic, another month of paying for a broken feature that logs me out every 5 minutes. Real great software.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer expresses frustration about a bug causing frequent logouts.
test_cases.notes: Sarcastic tone; tests if model focuses on the core technical bug (logouts) rather than getting confused by emotion.

test_cases.email_text: Hi, I was charged twice because your payment gateway froze during checkout. Also the app gave me an error 404.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer was charged twice due to a gateway freeze during checkout.
test_cases.notes: Ambiguous/Overlap: Mentions both technical failure (gateway freeze, 404) and billing (charged twice). Correct label is billing because the financial impact takes priority.

test_cases.email_text: Do you guys support custom enterprise invoicing and annual wire transfers?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer inquires about custom enterprise invoicing and annual wire transfer options.
test_cases.notes: Borderline between billing and general info.

test_cases.email_text: Where is my invoice for last month?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking for last month's invoice.

test_cases.email_text: Delete my account and all associated data permanently please.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer requests permanent deletion of their account and data.

test_cases.email_text: Is your API down right now? None of our webhooks are firing.
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer is asking if the API is down because webhooks are failing.

test_cases.email_text: Hi, what are your standard customer support hours over the weekend?
test_cases.expected_summary: Customer asks about support team operating hours over the weekend.
